definitions.explanation: The second year in a sequence, such as a school year or program. Commonly used in {二年生|にねんせい} (second-year student).

examples.japanese: {二年|にねん}{前|まえ}に{結婚|けっこん}した。
examples.english: I got married two years ago.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{二年|にねん}でこの{仕事|しごと}を{覚|おぼ}えた。
examples.english: He learned this job in two years.

examples.japanese: プロジェクトの{完成|かんせい}までに{二年|にねん}かかる{予定|よてい}です。
examples.english: The project is expected to take two years to complete.

examples.japanese: {高校|こうこう}{二年|にねん}のときに{初|はじ}めて{海外|かいがい}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went abroad for the first time in my second year of high school.

examples.japanese: {娘|むすめ}は{大学|だいがく}{二年生|にねんせい}です。
examples.english: My daughter is a second-year university student.

notes:
Means either 'two years' (duration) or 'second year' (ordinal position).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {二年|にねん}{前|まえ}: two years ago
- {二年|にねん}{後|ご}: two years from now
- {二年間|にねんかん}: for two years (emphasizes duration)
- {二年|にねん}{目|め}: the second year (ordinal)
- {二年生|にねんせい}: second-year student

YEAR COUNTING:
Years use {年|ねん}: {一年|いちねん}, {二年|にねん}, {三年|さんねん}, {四年|よねん} (note: {四|よ}, not し), {五年|ごねん}.
